title: Connect your calendar
summary: Connecting your Google or Outlook calendar keeps online bookings from landing on top of things you already have scheduled, and puts new visits on the calendar you already check.

steps.title: Open Connections
steps.body: In the menu, go to Calendars, then Connections.

steps.title: Connect Google or Outlook
steps.body: Click Connect for the calendar you use and sign in with the email address you use for appointments.

steps.title: Choose which calendars count
steps.body: Pick the calendars Banner Connect should check for conflicts, so personal and school events block those times. Then pick the calendar new visits should be added to.

steps.title: Check your available times
steps.body: Go to Calendars, then Meeting Calendars, and open Schedule a Visit. Make sure the days and hours match when you actually give visits.

check: Open your booking page and look at tomorrow. Any time you're already busy on your own calendar should be missing from the list.
